name: organization-profile
title: Organization profile
description: The organization the session acts in: its name, short name and creation date, the user's role, what that role allows and whether they can see or manage the members. Behaviour lives in useOrganization() of @tula-tech/react, whose has() decides what to show and never what to allow; this is presentation you own.
docs: Draw <OrganizationProfile /> inside <TulaProvider> from @tula-tech/react, for a signed-in user, where the environment has organizations switched on. Check permissions again on your server: the profile only shows what the access token says.
